title: Natural associativity and regular right unit for common-stage tensor
statement: Fix a prime l, a scheme X on which l is invertible, and an algebraic closure Omega of Q_l. Let C be the general algebraically closed constructible coefficient category and T its prescribed common-stage derived tensor bifunctor [def-weil-derived-pullback-tensor-hom]. For L in C set right(L) to the functor K ↦ T(K,L). For every L,M in C there is a natural isomorphism right(L) followed by right(M) ≅ right(T(L,M)). Moreover right of the prescribed degree-zero coefficient twist sfQbarTwistingCoefficient(l,X,Omega,0) [def-coefficient-twists-detailed] is naturally isomorphic to the identity functor. These are natural isomorphisms of the actual functors, not only objectwise equivalences, and the unit is the specified untwisted regular coefficient object.

proof.text: Use the normalized integral associator and right unitor of the actual completed tensor. Apply the faithful coherent reduction functor to their naturality squares; its natural tensor comparison reduces the squares to ordinary associator and unitor naturality. The regular sheaf in degree zero is derived complete and has exactly the coefficient-unit quotient system, so completeness identifies the reconstructed tensor unit with this specified object.

Localize these integral squares. Every rational morphism is a finite sum of pure coefficient tensors; bilinearity proves naturality on a pure tensor from the integral square and then on every morphism. The inverse identities localize as well.

Represent every object and map in each common-stage square over a single finite coefficient field. The normalized common-stage scalar tensor comparisons conjugate the associator and unitor components to their rational counterparts. Their tower and unit equations cancel the conjugations, so the squares commute by rational naturality. Eventual equality gives naturality in the pair quotient. Descend the inverse identities too and assemble with NatIso.ofComponents. The least-stage regular object is sfQbarTwistingCoefficient at zero by its defining intrinsic coefficient construction.

lean.statement:
theorem commonStageTensorLineCoherence
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (X : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ x : X, Invertible (l : X.residueField x)]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω] [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω] :
    let C := generalAlgebraicallyClosedConstructibleCategory l Ω X
    let T := commonStageDerivedTensor l Ω X
    let right (L : C) := (𝟭 C).prod' ((Functor.const C).obj L) ⋙ T
    (∀ (L M : C), Nonempty (right L ⋙ right M ≅ right (T.obj (L, M)))) ∧
      Nonempty (right (sfQbarTwistingCoefficient l X Ω 0) ≅ 𝟭 C)
